SYNTHETIC QA FIXTURE - FICTIONAL AGENCY AND PEOPLE - NOT AN OFFICIAL RECORD
Fictional Serai Transit Unit
Operational Readiness Note O-11, issued 06 October 2026 by Arif Lim.
The note schedules a staff rehearsal for 17 November 2026 at 14:00. The public launch is listed as 12 November 2026 and the layout lists three counters.
These launch/layout values conflict with revised Circular CVD-26-17 version 2, dated 05 October 2026, which proposes 19 November and two counters. This note gives no explanation for retaining the older values.
The note states: ramp access is operationally ready. No signed accessibility assessment is attached.
Human review is required before treating this readiness statement as formal accessibility clearance.
There is no procurement clearance reference in this note.
